tenderSchedule.deptName: Rural Drinking Water and Sanitation Department

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Before and after GPS Photographs shall be submitted
Bidders are bond the guidelines / instructions issued time to from the government
If any date in the tender time table is government holidays, nest working date will be considered
Corrigendums / modifications / correction if any will be published in the website only
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The Employer reserves the rights to reject any of all tenders without assigning any reason
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Tenderer shall have valid class - III KPWD / CPWD
In any one financial year out of last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 Turn over Certificate Certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number compulsory

As prime contractor at least one any construction of work such as of value not less than 25 percentage of amount put tender last 5 financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 not below rank of Executive Engineer
Assessed available tender capacity computed as per the formula in section 3.6
Reserved Category Certificate SC Bidders only
after reading the terms and conditions as per the bid documents. submit the bidders declaration on a letterhead

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Rejuvenation and Repairs of 63 Nos OHTs at various villages in Sedam Taluka under SDP EAP ( SC Bidders only)

itemList.description: Work 1: Repairs to OHT at Arebommanhalli-1, Bandempalli-1, Chitkanpalli-1, Bhutpur-1, Kachawar-1 village in Sedam Taluka (5 OHTs, A.A. Sl. 61, Chittapur Sub-Division 0.93 L model (ELSR repair per OHT) x 5 OHTs [no 0.93 L estimate received for this sub-division - Chittapur model adopted]) - Food Graded Water Proofing Membrane Providing and laying water proofing treatment to the Water tanks and Liquid Retaining structures with two component acrylic polymer modified cementitious waterproofing membrane with minimum elongation of 50% applied at 1.5 kg/m2 for internal side waterproofing in two layers with waiting period of 4-6 hrs per layer and food grade epoxy coating in two coats certified by CFTRI Mysuru, including surface preparation completely as per specification. [Com-VolI-I SR/I.No 15.6/Pg.no.150]

Ladder inside the container: Providing anodized aluminium ladder using 65mm x 32mm x 3.0mm C section for ladder side channel x 25mm dia., flutal pipe for Rungs at 250mm c/c ladder fixed at an angle of 70 degrees to horizontal including necessary 25mm dia., G.I. shutters with necessary G.I. fasteners for bracing the ladders to the Tank walls to prevent buckling of the ladder with necessary (M-15) bed for embedding the ladder bottom complete [Com-Vol-5 SR/I.No 7.12.1/Pg.no.88]

Finishing walls with water proofing cement paint of required shade :Old work (one coats applied at 2.20 kg/10 m2) over priming coat of primer applied at 0.80 l/10 m2 complete including cost of Priming coat including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning the surface to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. [Com 2023-24-Vol-II SR/I.No.8.72.1/Pg.no.52]

Providing and fixing MS inspection door of size 60 cms x 60 cms, including MS frame made of 50x50x6mm angle, shutters made of 3mm thick MS sheets, with hinges, locking arrangements at top etc. including painting with anticorrosive approved paint etc. complete including all lead and lifts etc. [Com-Vol-5 SR/I.No 7.3/Pg.no.85]

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Super structures of building , Road works, Water works, Irrigation works and super structure works of bridges upto 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators. The cost includes all lead and lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. [Com-Vol-1 SR/I.No.2.5.2/Pg.no.16]
